name: Steel Seraph — "gains your choice of flying, vigilance, or lifelink" is one option per keyword
notes: Memory: project_behavioural_audit_and_controller_restrictions_2026-10-11. "Your choice of A, B, or C" parsed to nothing. extractTriggeredAbilities / extractActivatedAbilities now offer one option per item (_yourChoiceOfOptions), fired like the "+1/-1 or -1/+1" options. Mode 1 is vigilance: the targeted Bears gain it, the other creature does not.
